# Diana Barry

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021)</sub>
- **Origin:** Orchard Slope  <sub>[v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v2 c29 P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Di  <sub>[v1 c18 P25](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0025)</sub>

## Appearance

Diana is a very pretty girl with black eyes and hair, inherited from her mother. She has rosy cheeks that feature snap and color, as well as a merry expression inherited from her father.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043)_

## Personality

Diana is good, smart, and friendly, though she can be nervous in emergencies. She loves to read and reads so much that her mother worries about her straining her eyes. She is close and devoted to her friends, enjoying secret-sharing and spending time outdoors.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022), [v1 c17 P29](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0029), [v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 c31 P0](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0000)_

## Traits

- good and smart  <sub>[v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040)</sub>
- avid reader  <sub>[v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022)</sub>

## Abilities

- making fashionable tissue paper bookmarkers  <sub>[v1 c17 P29](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0029)</sub>

## History

Diana lives at Orchard Slope in Avonlea. As a child, she became the sworn bosom friend of Anne Shirley shortly after meeting her. When her sister Minnie May fell severely ill with croup while her parents were away in town, Diana sought Anne's help. Although she did not join the Queen's class because her parents did not intend to send her to Queen's, she remained close to Anne and spent much time outdoors with her. She later served as the treasurer of the Avonlea Village Improvement Society. Eventually, Diana entered into a romantic courtship with Fred Wright.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c31 P0](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0000), [v2 c6 P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 c29 P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v2 c29 P15](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0015)_
